item.description:

I had a 2nd gen of this on tape way back when and it was one of my favorites, and eventually master transfers of both headliner and opener turned up. Speaking of which never saw anything of the brief Luscious Jackson reunion tour and I already had Throwing Muses / Tanya Donelly tix the same day. Damn. Just another reason why I pretty much just don't buy advance tix at all anymore as the latter ended up doing 2 nights anyway





Breeders
November 17, 1993
Lupo's Heartbreak Hotel
Providence, RI

FOR TRADING/SHARING ONLY

I've always been happy with the results of this recording, which had a lot to do with my taping location. Lupo's had a small balcony, more like a loft, that was a great place to see the show, but only if you were up front against the railing. (Anything further back was noisy and had an obstructed view.) A railing spot was tough to secure because there were so few, especially in relation to the club's capacity. However, I was lucky to get one on this particular night. It was a perfect view of the stage and provided an excellent recording opportunity, as the sound was clear and audience noise was minimal.

The show itself is one of my favorites, with a strong representation of material from Last Splash, as well as a good number of songs from Pod. Banter between Kelley and Kim is also priceless - it mostly revolves around Kelley's declaration that she had a bit too much to drink (at the very least). The performance doesn't suffer, though, so it's kept to a series of amusing exchanges between Kim and Kelley.
